title: Structure per-class spellcasting ability and prepared-spell counts
description: Level-1 spellcasting COUNTS are already structured on class progression rows (class.data.progression[level==1].spellcasting = {cantripsKnown, spellsKnown?, slots}). Two things remain prose-only: (1) the spellcasting ABILITY per class (Wizard=INT, Cleric=WIS, Bard=CHA, etc.), which lives in the 'Spellcasting' feature text and blocks spell save DC / spell attack (b69j.6 deferred these) and prepared-caster counts; (2) prepared-caster spell counts and Wizard spellbook starting size (Wizard prepares INT mod + level and starts with 6 spellbook spells; Cleric/Druid/Paladin prepare ability mod + level/half-level) — these are formulas in feature prose, not the progression table.
acceptance_criteria: Add structured spellcastingAbility to the class schema/importer, and structured prepared-count metadata (formula or known/prepared discriminator) sufficient to compute level-1 spell selection counts without prose parsing. Regenerate via importer (docs/importer-fix-protocol.md) with audit coverage. derivedValues.ts can then compute spell save DC = 8 + prof + ability mod and spell attack. Likely files: importers, kindSchemas.ts validateDnd5eClass, rulesPackResolver.ts, derivedValues.ts.
notes: Implemented via consumer-side overlay (srdClassSpellcasting.ts), mirroring eshyra-b69j.12.1. PR #299 open for review: https://github.com/jbongaarts/eshyra/pull/299. Per-class spellcasting ability + prepared/known/spellbook metadata; deriveLevel1Values computes spell save DC / attack (closes b69j.6 deferral); enumerateLevel1RequiredChoices structures level-1 spell count and drops the prose-only spellcasting-ability gap; Ranger empty L1 row no longer emits spurious spell choices. No importer/extractor/frozen-pack files touched. verify:worktree green (2456 passed/19 skipped).
close_reason: Merged via PR #299.
